system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
## Project Kestrel — buyer review

The Seller’s assertions that its positions are “market,” agreed at principal level and final do not establish buyer approval. In particular, **neither the 20% general cap nor the 18-month general claims period is authorised** under Wattlebridge’s playbook.

| Issue | Seller’s position | Buyer should want | Recommendation and one-line reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001: General liability cap** | 20% of price: **AUD 4.8m**. | 25%: **AUD 6m**; 20% is available only with Amelia Frost’s prior written authority identifying the draft. | **Reject and mark up to 25%.** No authority for the conditional fallback has been given. |
| **SPA-N-002: De minimis & basket** | AUD 25,000 de minimis; AUD 250,000 basket, with recovery only of the excess. | AUD 5,000 de minimis; AUD 50,000 aggregate basket, recoverable **from the first dollar once exceeded**. | **Replace both thresholds and the excess-only mechanism.** The Seller’s terms materially reduce recoverable claims. |
| **SPA-N-003: General claims time limit** | Notice within 18 months after Completion; limitations apply to all claims unless expressly excluded. | 24 months after Completion; 18 months requires Amelia’s written approval. | **Mark up to 24 months and remove the blanket extension.** Neither the shorter period nor its application to other categories is authorised. |
| **SPA-N-004: Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title subject to general caps and time limits. | Separate regime with a **100% cap**, at least six years, and no general basket, de minimis or buyer-knowledge bar. | **Create an express separate regime.** Administrative convenience does not justify general-warranty protection for fundamental claims. |
| **SPA-N-005: Fraud carve-out** | Limitations, exclusive remedy and non-reliance apply to claims of any nature. | Carve out fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct from **all caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance**, to the maximum extent enforceable. | **Insert an overriding, non-waivable carve-out.** The Seller’s universal wording conflicts with a mandatory buyer protection. |
| **SPA-N-006: Disclosure scope** | Deems the entire data room, accounts, registers and public records disclosed. | Specific **fair disclosure**; no whole-data-room, public-register or prudent-search deemed disclosure. | **Delete general deemed disclosures and test each specific disclosure.** Mere availability does not establish fair disclosure against a particular warranty. |
| **SPA-N-007: Buyer knowledge qualifier** | Bars matters known to the Buyer or advisers, including matters discoverable from the data room or public records. | Delete the blanket exclusion; any negotiated qualifier needs named Seller knowledge persons and reasonable enquiry, and must never excuse title, capacity, fraud or a specific indemnity. | **Reject clause 8.3 as drafted.** Discoverability and adviser knowledge would transfer undisclosed risk to the Buyer. |
| **SPA-N-008: Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; condition satisfied upon delivery of written consent. No final consent or evidence of satisfied conditions is included. | Effective consent **and evidence all its conditions are satisfied before Completion**. | **Make both a Completion condition.** Delivery alone or reasonable endeavours does not secure the material customer relationship. |
| **SPA-N-009: Riverlark facility** | Approximately AUD 3.2m outstanding; release to follow Completion. No repayment or final discharge is included. | Current payout statement, direct repayment from Completion funds and effective security releases; any post-Completion release needs an irrevocable undertaking and Amelia’s approval. | **Build payoff and releases into Completion mechanics.** A later release leaves debt and security risk outstanding. |
| **SPA-N-010: Employee bonuses** | DD-005 records AUD 420,000 conditional bonuses; they are not itemised in the funds flow and on-costs are undetermined. | Expressly itemise the bonuses **plus triggered on-costs**, or make them Seller-funded. | **Resolve conditions and on-costs and revise the funds flow.** They must not be silently excluded from completion economics. |
| **SPA-N-011: Ironquay IP indemnity** | Indemnity limited to the SOW3 payment; DD-010 shows AUD 180,000 open, without independent verification either way. | Broader indemnity addressing the Ironquay IP exposure, while preserving the SOW3 cure; verify payment and obtain appropriate ownership/assignment evidence. | **Broaden the indemnity and investigate payment and title.** Cleared payment conditions transfer, but the open amount is not proof of non-payment. |
| **SPA-N-012: Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary matter said not expected to be material; access, scope and notification remain unestablished. | Preserve logs, investigate promptly and require updates on scope, access, remediation and any notification assessment. | **Add investigation, preservation and reporting obligations.** Do not assume a breach, harm, notification duty or numeric demand in either direction. |
| **SPA-N-013: Sandbar renewals** | Treats AUD 330,000 aggregate renewals as ordinary-course operating costs. | Assess DD-008 and DD-011 together for timing, scope, accrual, termination and avoidability. | **Investigate before determining treatment.** Do not automatically classify the renewals as Debt or deduct them from price. |
| **SPA-N-014: Category separation** | Proposes general limitations for all claims unless expressly stated otherwise; Tax/IP treated under the general regime. | Keep **Title, Tax, IP, payment and covenant** categories separate, with each applicable regime expressly stated and no hidden general override. | **Revise the hierarchy and cross-references throughout.** A blanket limitations provision could override negotiated category-specific protection. |
| **SPA-N-015: Title verification** | Relies on DD-012, the Company share register, for 100% ownership. | Independent evidence of title, ownership, encumbrance status and Seller authority. | **Obtain independent verification before Completion.** DD-012 is a supplied internal source, not independent proof. |
| **SPA-N-016: Tax/IP open terms** | Says Tax and IP warranty positions are settled under the general regime. | Treat Tax and IP terms as **open**, negotiate their scope and applicable remedies separately, and preserve category separation. | **Reject the assertion of settlement and reserve both issues.** There is no established resolution or basis to assume unlimited liability. |

**Other DD points:** DD-007 describes an office-lease **notification**, not a landlord-consent requirement; DD-009 restricts assignment but does not establish that a share sale itself requires Mossvale consent. Verify and address the actual obligations without assuming either consent is required.
=== END ADVICE ===
